title: Maternity Leave Policy
content: Hawkeye Nest Technologies Pvt Ltd (the Company) provides eligible female employees with fully paid Maternity Leave of up to 180 days (approximately 26 weeks) to support childbirth and postpartum recovery. This policy complies with the Maternity Benefit Act. Maternity leave must be applied for at least 4 weeks in advance with proper medical documentation. Paternity leave is also available for male employees for up to 15 days. Maternity leave cannot be encashed or carried forward to the next financial year.

title: Attendance and Working Hours Policy
content: Our official working hours are 09:30 AM to 06:30 PM, Monday through Friday, with a standard weekend policy of Saturday & Sunday off. Employees must mark their daily attendance using web check-in or the biometric device. A grace period is allowed until 10:00 AM, after which check-in is marked as late entry. Attendance records are directly integrated with payroll calculations.

title: Work from Home (WFH) Policy
content: The company supports a flexible work environment. Employees are eligible to request up to 4 days of Work From Home (WFH) per month, subject to manager approval. During WFH, employees must remain accessible via email, Chat, and calls during core working hours (10:00 AM to 05:00 PM). High-speed internet connection is required to ensure productivity.

title: Leave Benefits and Entitlements Policy
content:
The company provides the following annual leave entitlements for all active employees:
1. Casual Leave (CL): 12 days. Carry forward: Yes, Encash: No.
2. Sick Leave (SL): 15 days. Carry forward: Yes, Encash: No.
3. Privilege Leave (PL): 10 days. Carry forward: Yes, Encash: Yes.
4. Earned Leave (EL): 30 days. Carry forward: Yes, Encash: Yes.
5. Paternity Leave (PTL): 15 days. Carry forward: No, Encash: No.
6. Bereavement Leave (BL): 7 days. Carry forward: No, Encash: No.
7. Compensatory Off (COMP): Up to 10 days. Carry forward: No, Encash: No.
